title: 'Fast walkers' code word for UFOs in space

tellings.quote: US Space Force, uh, Northcom, Space, um, NORAD, they actually have a term for UFOs in space, which it's, uh, fast walkers.

plain: The US military has its own name for unidentified objects moving in space: "fast walkers," according to the researcher Maaneli Derakhshani. He says the term is used by the US Space Force, by NORTHCOM (the military command that defends North America) and by NORAD (the joint US and Canadian air and space defence command), and he gives it without naming a source. If true, it would mean the military tracks such objects often enough to need a word for them.
